시편-32-1.title: 시편 32장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-32-1.exegesis: 23-24. the Lord ... proud doer-- literally, "the Lord is keeping faith," that is, with His people, and is repaying, &c. Then let none despair, but take courage; their hopes shall not be in vain.
시편-32-1.theologicalNote: 23-24. the Lord ... proud doer-- literally, "the Lord is keeping faith," that is, with His people, and is repaying, &c. Then let none despair, but take courage; their hopes shall not be in vain.

시편-32-2.title: 시편 32장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-32-2.exegesis: PSALM 32 Psa 32:1-11 . Maschil--literally, "giving instruction." The Psalmist describes the blessings of His forgiveness, succeeding the pains of conviction, and deduces from his own experience instruction and exhortation to others. 1-2. (Compare Ro 4:6 ). forgiven-- literally, "taken away," opposed to retain ( Joh 20:23 ). covered-- so that God no longer regards the sin ( Psa 85:3 ).

시편-32-4.title: 시편 32장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-32-4.exegesis: 3-4. A vivid description of felt, but unacknowledged, sin. When-- literally, "for," as in Psa 32:4 .

시편-32-6.title: 시편 32장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-32-6.exegesis: 5. A prompt fulfilment of the purposed confession is followed by a prompt forgiveness.
시편-32-6.theologicalNote: 5. A prompt fulfilment of the purposed confession is followed by a prompt forgiveness.

시편-32-7.title: 시편 32장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-32-7.exegesis: 6. For this-- that is, my happy experience. godly-- pious in the sense of Psa 4:3 . a time-- ( Is 55:6 ); when God's Spirit inclines us to seek pardon, He is ready to forgive. floods, &c.-- denotes great danger ( Psa 18:17 ; 66:12 ).

시편-32-8.exegesis: 7. His experience illustrates the statement of Psa 32:6 .

시편-32-9.title: 시편 32장 9절 역사문법적 주해
시편-32-9.exegesis: 8. Whether, as most likely, the language of David (compare Psa 51:13 ), or that of God, this is a promise of divine guidance. I will ... mine eye-- or, My eye shall be on thee, watching and directing thy way.
